MediaPipeManager

class MediaPipeManager[source]

Bases: object

Create and hold the MediaPipe pose landmarker.

The model file and detector options come from CalibrationService.

Attributes:
serviceCalibrationService

Source of the MediaPipe settings.

detectormediapipe.tasks.python.vision.PoseLandmarker

The configured pose landmarker.

Notes

On a Raspberry Pi the embedded model is loaded (get_mediapipe_model_embedded); on other systems the desktop model (get_mediapipe_model_desktop). Both are resolved with PathConfig.model.

The running mode, number of poses and the minimum detection, presence and tracking confidences are also read from the service when the object is created.

Methods

detect_for_video

Run pose detection on one video frame.
detect_for_video(mp_image, timestamp_ms)[source]

Run pose detection on one video frame.

Parameters:
mp_imagemediapipe.Image

Frame to analyze, in SRGB format.

timestamp_msint

Frame timestamp in milliseconds.

Returns:
mediapipe.tasks.python.vision.PoseLandmarkerResult

Detection result, with pose_landmarks holding one landmark list per detected pose.

Notes

Only valid when the landmarker runs in VIDEO mode. MediaPipe requires timestamp_ms to increase monotonically between calls; CameraVideoThread.run takes care of that.
